caveats: Development data previously used in model/rule selection; not independent confirmation.
Three differently sampled populations are not a representative pooled accuracy estimate.
Gold labels include unclassified outcomes and varying human/agent provenance.
Credit set has 12 exact-input groups with conflicting gold; unique-input sensitivity excludes those groups.
Blank merchant and related narrative templates limit claims of merchant-family independence.
Quality-only offline execution; not a latency, payload integration or deployed-container test.
